descriptionChirho: The Chaldean people, the inhabitants of southern Mesopotamia, often appearing as aggressors or as an ethnic-national designation (כַּשְׂדִּים plural).
The geographical territory of the Chaldeans in southern Mesopotamia, used as a place name with directional or locative force (כַּשְׂדִּימָה / אֶרֶץ כַּשְׂדִּים).
